title: fix(service-settings): a select, radio or multiselect setting refuses every value when its option source answers an empty list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1nhftM2hZHHvqk2GLFyVTN)_

domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nBSzc6ktJyjdFcDb3

Fixes #31550

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (a select / radio / multiselect value is refused when its registered option source answered an empty list; it was accepted at both doors before)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:select / radio / multiselect 设置的值,按该键注册的选项来源判定;来源答了「空列表」时,以前保存门与 `OS_*` 环境变量门都跳过校验、任何值都放行;现在两道门都拒绝(保存 `invalid_option`「… offers no value to choose from right now.」,环境变量记一条 error 且不生效),与 #31422 对 map 键的规则一致。顺带:环境变量拒绝日志的去重改按稳定序列化,同一变量下两份不同的坏 map 各报一次(以前所有 map 都被当成 `[object Object]`,第二份被吞)。
- 为什么改:#31539 契约复审的 Finding 1 与一条观察。
- 风险与回滚:收窄,只影响「已注册来源答了空列表」的 select 族键。启动窗口:`localization.locale` 的来源在 i18n 列表为空时答的是「无答案」(`undefined`),不是空列表,所以走声明选项;环境变量门在启动期间(`holdOptionSourceVerdicts` 到 `kernel:bootstrapped` 封存)对来源判定一律先放行并在封存时重判(有对照 pin)。没有来源、或来源答不出时,仍按声明选项判定。service-settings 全量测试全绿。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` 的 `validatePatch` select 分支、`effectiveEnvOverride` select 分支、`reportRejectedEnvOverride` 的 `dedupeAt`;新 pin `settings-select-empty-source-31550.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-select-empty-source-31550.test.ts`,预期 9 条全绿;其中 5 条在 main 上是红的。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(收窄,落地前席位做契约复审)。

## What changes

- **`validatePatch`, the option-bearing branch** (`service-settings`): it reads `sourced` from `optionTableOf` (#31539) and judges the value whenever a source answered (`sourced || allowed.length > 0`). The `allowed.length > 0` leniency stays for the declared table alone (a hand-built manifest with no options). An empty sourced table refuses with `invalid_option` and the sentence "`<Label>` offers no value to choose from right now." (the value echoed unless the key is encrypted), constraint `{ allowed: '' }`.
- **`effectiveEnvOverride`, the option family**: the same rule. The refusal's detail reads "Allowed values: none (the running system offers no value right now)." The boot hold is untouched: a sourced refusal while held is taken in force and judged again at the seal.
- **`reportRejectedEnvOverride`**: the "said once" key is `envName=` plus `stableStringify(value)` for an object or array (the file's own order-independent serialiser), `String(value)` for a scalar as before. Every map used to key as `[object Object]`.

## How the boot window is covered (`localization.locale`)

- The key with real reach is `localization.locale`. Its source (`localizationLocaleOptionSource`) answers `undefined`, not an empty list, when the i18n service reports no locale, so the declared four apply and nothing here changes for it while the list is empty.
- The `OS_*` door is held from `SettingsServicePlugin.init` (`holdOptionSourceVerdicts`) to `kernel:bootstrapped` (`sealOptionSources`). While held, a sourced key's refusal (an empty answer included) is taken in force, unreported and remembered; at the seal it is judged against the list as it then stands, said once if still refused, and a change is emitted. Pinned: an override held over an empty list stays in force when the list fills before the seal, and is judged and said once when it is still empty at the seal.
- The save door has no hold. A save during the boot window against a source that answers an empty list would be refused; no shipped source does that (the locale source answers `undefined`), and a save comes over HTTP after the boot.

## Tests

New `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-select-empty-source-31550.test.ts` (9 rows), over a synthetic `pick_lab` manifest with two sourced keys (`select`, `multiselect`) and one unsourced `select`:

- Save door: an empty answer refuses a select and a multiselect value (`invalid_option`, nothing stored). Controls: the value saves once the source offers it; a source that cannot answer leaves the declared options; an unsourced key is judged against its declared options.
- Env door: an `OS_PICK_LAB_CHANNEL` override over an empty answer is not in force (one error line, the default reads). Controls: the boot hold above; a source that cannot answer leaves the declared options.
- Dedupe: two different bad `OS_LIFECYCLE_QUOTAS` maps are each said once; the same map with its keys reordered is not said again.

## Acceptance notes

- **Responsibility.** Finding 1 and an observation of the at-tier contract review of PR #31539 (6722607950), noted in #31422's os-dev-report (6722247790).
- **Narrowing, stated.** A select-family value under a registered source that answers an empty list, saved or in `OS_*`, was accepted and is refused now. No value could be one the running system offers, so nothing that worked stops working.
- **Worktree.** The claim names `objectstack-issue-31550`; this ran in the chain's existing worktree `objectstack-issue-31317` on the same claimed branch, cut from fresh `origin/main` after #31539 merged.

- Env door: the same in `effectiveEnvOverride`, blob to fb851f1300fa: Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9), the env row and the hold row.
